messages:
noelle (AE): Mercury (payments platform) asked for a short, concrete capacity + pricing recommendation for their 8-week POC. Profile: baseline ~200 RPS, short peaks to ~600 RPS for 10-20m, avg request ~3k tokens. They want reserved vs burst options, VPC peering, CMK, and audit logs.
kiran (Solutions): Quick clarifiers: are spikes single-region? Any hard p99 SLO asks?
noelle (AE): US-west primary, brief EU footprint. They asked for p95 < 1s and p99 < 3s if feasible; willing to accept token-size carveouts.
omar (Infra): Ballpark math: 600 * 3k = 1.8M tokens/sec peak. With q4-13B on H100 and good batching we see 18-22k tokens/sec/GPU when well-batched; KV session caching and prefix reuse usually yields 3-4x effective reduction. Recommendation: baseline reserved pool sized for steady 200 RPS and autoscale for bursts. Primary model: 13B q4-int8; fallback: 7B quantized.
lucy (SRE): Proposed sizing: baseline = 8 H100 (handles ~180-220 RPS with batching+kv), autoscale to max=24 for bursts. Prewarm=3 nodes. Autoscale params: min=8, max=24, scale_up_step=4, scale_down_step=2, cooldown=45s, prewarm_nodes=3. KV preheat for top 250 sessions.
ben (Pricing): I'll prepare two-line quote: (A) Hosted Reserved: monthly reserved for 8 GPUs + token overage; (B) Private: same topology + infra surcharge + CMK support. For POC we can offer 15% discount on reserved and 5 preheat credits. Need infra perf CSV to finalize $/token rows.
sec-bot: Security: VPC peering supported; CMK supported in Private; audit logs available, retention configurable. Recommend Private if Mercury needs strict compliance.
kiran (Solutions): Operational notes to share with customer: fallback routing to 7B pool on SLO breach, model-hedging sampling 5% to heavy model during fallback for quality checks, and automatic rollback on error-rate >2% during canary.
omar (Infra): Sample autoscale snippet to include in reply (paste into their ops):
```
{
  "autoscale": {
    "min_gpus": 8,
    "max_gpus": 24,
    "scale_up_step": 4,
    "scale_down_step": 2,
    "cooldown_sec": 45,
    "prewarm_nodes": 3,
    "routing_policy": "latency_priority"
  }
}
```
lucy (SRE): Failure modes: if prewarm fails -> route to 7B fallback pool and enable graceful truncation for very long completions; if cloud quota blocks scale -> queue with backpressure and soft-degraded responses. I'll draft a short runbook for preheat/fallback.
noelle (AE): Action items: omar/kiran run perf at 8/16/24 GPUs and post CSVs (p50/p95/p99, token/sec, kv_hit_ratio); ben to send draft pricing; sec-bot attach SOC2/KMS blurb; lucy draft runbook. I'll send Mercury the two-option POC plan once we have perf numbers.
kiran (Solutions): I'll kick off perf sim now and post results later today.
ben (Pricing): Will share draft numbers by EOD tomorrow.
lucy (SRE): I'll join the customer handoff call and review runbook.
noelle (AE): Thanks team, target reply to Mercury tomorrow morning with perf + pricing.
